new_code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 4 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            cells = {(r, c)}
            seen.add((r, c))
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); cells.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            objects.append((color, cells))

    def norm(cells):
        y0=min(y for y,x in cells); x0=min(x for y,x in cells)
        return tuple(sorted((y-y0,x-x0) for y,x in cells))

    # Find the largest 9-colored right-angle line and its corner orientation.
    marks=[]
    for color,cells in objects:
        if color != 9 or len(cells) < 6:
            continue
        ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
        y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
        corners=[]
        for cy,cx in cells:
            arms=[]
            for dy,dx in ((-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)):
                n=0; yy,xx=cy+dy,cx+dx
                while (yy,xx) in cells:
                    n+=1; yy+=dy; xx+=dx
                if n: arms.append((dy,dx,n))
            if any(dy for dy,dx,n in arms) and any(dx for dy,dx,n in arms):
                corners.append((cy,cx,arms))
        if not corners: continue
        cy,cx,arms=max(corners,key=lambda z:len(z[2]))
        vertical=[a for a in arms if a[1]==0]; horizontal=[a for a in arms if a[0]==0]
        if not vertical or not horizontal: continue
        vy=max(vertical,key=lambda a:a[2])[0]; hx=max(horizontal,key=lambda a:a[2])[1]
        marks.append((len(cells),cy,cx,vy,hx,cells))
    if not marks:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _,cy,cx,vy,hx,mark=max(marks,key=lambda z:z[0])
    # The selected side is opposite the two arms of the corner.
    candidates=[]
    for i,(color,cells) in enumerate(objects):
        if cells == mark: continue
        ys=[y for y,x in cells]; xs=[x for y,x in cells]
        # open quadrant, with either coordinate permitted to lie on the arm extension
        in_open = (all((y-cy)*vy < 0 for y in ys) and all((x-cx)*hx < 0 for x in xs))
        if not in_open: continue
        shape=norm(cells)
        partners=[(j,other) for j,(oc,other) in enumerate(objects) if j!=i and other!=mark and norm(other)==shape]
        if partners:
            dist=min((y-cy)**2+(x-cx)**2 for y,x in cells)
            candidates.append((dist,-len(cells),cells))
    if not candidates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    _,_,target=min(candidates,key=lambda z:(z[0],z[1]))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for y,x in target: out[y][x]=9
    return out
'''
